description: This file defines the 'SeoMetaPartDisplayDriver' class, which manages the display and update logic for SEO metadata parts within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering different SEO-related views and processing form submissions for editing SEO metadata, including OpenGraph, Twitter, and Google Schema data.

classes.name: SeoMetaPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing the display and editing of SEO metadata parts in OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the display results for editing the SEO metadata part, including optional sections for OpenGraph, Twitter, and Google Schema based on settings.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous update of the SEO metadata part from form input, validating and assigning values for various SEO fields.
